author: Alfredo3339
quote: Between the wokism, "the need to be more empathetic", the limitations that you have when you play (can't shoot more than 2 things, can't steal a car, can't have an affair or have relationships with no one), the 30 fps limit, and all the bugs it has, when it took 13 years and 2 billion dollars, make me more and more confident in my decision not to buy that game. All those things are based on a fan's point of view, but if you are new to the franchise I think you need to wait until it is released to PC, more Fps and Mods, the community will be working in how to make gta a good game again.
